description: Compares a maker's cash rebate taken with the person's own loan against the maker's special APR (with any cash that combines with it): each side's payment, interest and total, the difference, the own-loan rate where the two cost the same, and the sales tax a rebate saves in states that tax the price after it. Give the amount financed before the rebate, or a vehicle price to work it out.

amount_financed_before_rebate.description: Out-the-door price before the rebate, less down payment and trade equity

city.description: City or county in the state's rate table (23 states; state_rules says which), like Pittsburgh or Allegheny County: sets the combined rate from the state's own rate file. Where a city is in several counties (Chicago, Milwaukee), give county too. A place name only, never an address or ZIP

county.description: County from the state's list (Pennsylvania, Nevada, Wisconsin; state_rules lists them), like Allegheny County: sets the combined rate. A county name only, never an address or ZIP

doc_fee.description: Doc fee; leave out to assume the state's cap, or a typical $450 where there is none

own_apr.description: Your own loan APR in percent (a pre-approval)

promo_apr.description: The maker's special APR in percent

promo_cash.description: Cash that combines with the special APR

promo_term_months.description: The special APR's longest term, if shorter

rebate.description: Cash rebate available with your own loan or cash

state.description: Two-letter state code (DC included), like PA

tax_rate.description: Combined sales tax rate as a decimal; leave out to use the state's rate

vehicle_price.description: Vehicle price, to work out the amount financed instead

name: rebate_vs_apr
title: Cash rebate or special APR
